correctness.rationale: For the homotopy-equivalent deleted-square model D, the relative pair (G×G,D) has only E degree-2 generators. The LES is exact over integers, the coefficient map is Phi(z tensor w)(e)=z_e w_e, and edge-disjoint cactus cycle supports make its diagonal image a rank-b primitive lattice. This proves torsion-free H1,H2 and all ranks. The minus-factor-exchange rule for oriented 2-cells and rational equivariant exactness prove the eigen dimensions. A standalone finite checker reconstructs all product-boundary matrices for seven cactus fixtures over four prime fields, but does not replace the proof.

Searches include both object aliases and the stronger all-graph implication comparison. Relevant source sections were materially examined, while unlocated equivalents remain a residual risk.

value.rationale: Cactus graphs are a canonical structurally intermediate family between trees and arbitrary graphs. The classification gives complete integral low-dimensional homology and the rational transposition character for every such graph, independent of how its cycles attach. Its b>=2 cases have genuinely nonzero H2 and illuminate how edge-disjoint cycles control configuration topology; this exact two-particle collision-space invariant was not supplied by the inspected tree-only literature.
